title: Southern France · Riviera · Provence · Lavender — June 2027

itinerary.labelHtml:
The Itinerary

Day by day

Swipe each carousel for photos. Every stop carries its cost, June weather, a 💰 save tip, an ✨ splurge, picky-kid restaurants, backup / if-time ideas, blog links, and a map. Per-day costs are food + activities only.

days.heading: Depart Pittsburgh after work
days.note: Work the full day Monday, then fly overnight. There is no realistic PIT–NCE nonstop; expect one or two connections.

days.heading: Arrive Nice → easy beach evening

facts.label: Plan
facts.valueHtml: Land, tram/taxi to lodging, no car yet if possible

days.note: Arrival day costs a PTO day. Delay car pickup until leaving Nice if rates allow.

spots.cost: Free beach; loungers/umbrella €20–45; casual dinner €70–120 for four.
spots.climate: 75–78°F day / 64–67°F night; sea near 70°F, swimmable but brisk after wind.
spots.saveHtml: 💰 Save Use the public pebble beach, Cours Saleya picnic supplies, and water shoes.
spots.splurgeHtml: ✨ Splurge Reserve one private-beach half-day if jet lag demands shade, showers, and service.
spots.restoHtml:
• La Voglia Nice — Google typically ~4.3; huge pizzas/pastas €17–28.
  • Big Fernand Nice — Burgers/fries €13–18; easy plain-order option.
  • Di Più Nice — Seafront Italian; pizza/pasta mains usually €16–26.

facts.label: Plan
facts.valueHtml: Hill village early, Villefranche beach after

facts.label: Plan
facts.valueHtml: Antibes ramparts, Picasso option, sandy beach

spots.climate: 76–80°F; sandy beaches are easier than Nice pebbles.
spots.saveHtml: 💰 Save Use public sand at Juan-les-Pins and keep the museum optional.
spots.splurgeHtml: ✨ Splurge Book a private beach half-day if everyone wants showers, shade, and loungers.
spots.restoHtml:
• Le Pimm's Antibes — Google often ~4.4; pizza, pasta, burgers, €14–24.
  • Choopy's Antibes — Brunch, pancakes, burgers/sandwiches, €10–18.
  • Pizza Fifi Antibes — Budget pizza takeaway near the old town.

facts.label: Plan
facts.valueHtml: Pick up rental car, drive ~2.5–3.25 hrs

days.note: Juneteenth is observed Friday Jun 18, 2027, so this transfer day costs no PTO. The A8 is not romantic, but it prevents a backtracking mess later.

spots.cost: Autoroute tolls roughly €22–28 plus fuel; Cassis parking often €15–30/day.
spots.climate: 78–82°F; treat this as a transfer, not a sightseeing marathon.
spots.saveHtml: 💰 Save Take the fast A8/A52; the scenic coast turns this into a 5–6 hour day.
spots.splurgeHtml: ✨ Splurge Stop at Cap Canaille before check-in if everyone is awake.
spots.restoHtml:
• Le Bonaparte Cassis — Pizza/pasta safety net, €15–24.
  • La Stazione Cassis — Pizza/pasta/burgers near center.
  • Snack Les Calanques Cassis — Sandwiches/fries/ice cream near the port zone.
spots.altboxHtml: • Saint-Raphael ↩ for a stretch stop if traffic is bad.

facts.label: Plan
facts.valueHtml: Morning calanques boat, Port-Miou or Bestouan after

days.note: The wind/fire-risk-sensitive day. Boats run weather permitting; land access is regulated Jun 1–Sep 30.

spots.climate: 77–81°F; water 67–70°F. Boats run weather permitting; land access can close for fire risk Jun–Sep.
spots.saveHtml: 💰 Save Book the 5-calanque circuit, not the longest one.
spots.splurgeHtml: ✨ Splurge Book a small-group swim/snorkel boat if actual swim stops matter.
spots.restoHtml:
• Le Grand Large Cassis — Beachfront basics; kids can find fries/pasta/fish and chips, mains €18–32.
  • Le Bonaparte Cassis — Repeatable pizza/pasta safety net.
  • Maison Casalini Cassis — Gelato/crepes/sandwiches for a low-commitment lunch.

spots.saveHtml: 💰 Save Keep this as a low-plan swim/recovery day.
spots.splurgeHtml: ✨ Splurge Hire a guided tandem kayak if conditions are calm.
spots.restoHtml:

  • Le Patio Cassis — Pasta/kid-friendly basics, mains often €18–30.
  • Amorino Cassis — Gelato reward near the port.

facts.label: Plan

days.note: Aix is the civilized middle: laundry, parking, market, and casual restaurants.

spots.splurgeHtml: ✨ Splurge Do a private food walk if the kids are game.

  • La Pizza Aix-en-Provence — Pizza/pasta, roughly €14–24.
  • Maison Nosh Aix-en-Provence — Bagels/bowls/fries, around €10–18.
spots.altboxHtml: • Atelier de Cezanne ↩ if the market is too hot.

days.heading: Valensole lavender + Lac de Sainte-Croix

facts.label: Plan
facts.valueHtml: Early lavender loop, afternoon lake swim

days.note: Late June is close to the sweet spot but not a promise; Valensole usually strengthens toward late June/early July.

spots.cost: Fields free; lake parking/pedal boat €10–45; fuel for the loop.
spots.climate: 82–88°F; Jun 22 is likely visible lavender but not guaranteed peak — think 50–75% odds for strong Valensole color.
spots.saveHtml: 💰 Save Go early for lavender, lake after lunch.
spots.splurgeHtml: ✨ Splurge Rent an electric boat/pedal boat at Sainte-Croix.
spots.restoHtml:
• Le Comptoir de Valérie Valensole — Cafe/brasserie; simple plates €14–24, limited picky options.
  • Brasserie du Plateau Valensole — Casual plates, check same-day hours.
  • McDonald's Manosque — Honest backup: rural lavender towns are the hardest picky-eater zone.
spots.altboxHtml: • Sault lavender route ↩ if bloom reports say Valensole is weak.
spots.bloglinksHtml: Routes de la Lavande floweringMarseille lavender timing

days.heading: Avignon + Pont du Gard
days.daycost: Est. ~$340 · tickets + parking + kayak option + meals

facts.label: Plan
facts.valueHtml: Avignon Palais early, Pont du Gard + river swim after

days.note: A single big day from the Aix base — roughly 2.5–3 hrs of total driving (Aix→Avignon ~1 hr, Avignon→Pont du Gard ~25 min, Pont du Gard→Aix ~1 hr 15) to cover both Roman-Provence highlights; this exact pairing is a well-worn day-trip route from the Aix base. The Palais has 2026–2027 visitor-path changes, so re-check before booking.

spots.saveHtml: 💰 Save Use Palais des Papes underground parking once, then walk.
spots.splurgeHtml: ✨ Splurge Add a guided/WebApp/HistoPad-style visit so the palace works for kids.
spots.restoHtml:
• Le Vintage Avignon — Google often ~4.5; burgers/fries €14–22.
  • Vivotto Caffe Avignon — Fast-casual Italian bowls/pasta, €10–16.
  • Ginette et Marcel Avignon — Tartines, fries, casual plates.

spots.climate: 83–88°F; river is refreshing and shade is limited.
spots.saveHtml: 💰 Save Skip the museum if kids only want bridge + swim.
spots.splurgeHtml: ✨ Splurge Reserve a Gardon kayak float if water levels and age rules line up.
spots.restoHtml:
• Les Terrasses Pont du Gard — On-site and convenient; pricier but simple plates/fries exist.
  • Pizza de la Place Remoulins — Budget pizza fallback near the site.
  • Le Comptoir du 7 Uzes — Burgers/salads/brasserie plates €15–28.
spots.altboxHtml: • Uzes ↩ for ice cream/town time if swimming is off.

days.heading: Drive to MRS, fly home
days.note: Aix to MRS is a short ~25–30 min drive — budget extra time for rental return and airport buffer, not the road. Avoid central Marseille unless there is a reason.

:root{color-scheme:light;--ink:#1a1712;--muted:#6b645a;--paper:#f6f1e7;--card:#fffdf8;
 --line:rgba(26,23,18,.12);--c1:#1f6f78;--c2:#c25a3a;--c3:#3f7d4e;--gold:#d9a441;
 --save:#3f7d4e;--splurge:#a9862b;--shadow:0 18px 46px rgba(30,32,28,.14)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);
 font:16px/1.55 "Inter",ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:"Fraunces","Georgia",serif;letter-spacing:-.01em}
a{color:var(--c1)}
.eyebrow{margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--c2);font-size:.72rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase}
/* HERO */
header{position:relative;min-height:90vh;display:grid;align-items:end;padding:40px clamp(20px,5vw,80px) 54px;color:#fff;overflow:hidden}
header::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
 background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(10,20,24,.12),rgba(10,18,22,.34) 45%,rgba(8,14,18,.88)),var(--hero-url) center 40% / cover;transform:scale(1.03);z-index:-1}
.hero-inner{max-width:1100px}
header .kicker{display:inline-flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin:0 0 20px;padding:7px 15px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);border-radius:999px;font-size:.74rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
h1{margin:0 0 18px;font-size:clamp(2.9rem,9vw,7rem);line-height:.9;font-weight:600;text-shadow:0 2px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
header .lead{max-width:640px;margin:0 0 26px;font-size:clamp(1.05rem,2.1vw,1.3rem);color:rgba(255,255,255,.94);line-height:1.5}
.hero-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:26px}
.hero-meta div{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.hero-meta b{font-family:"Fraunces",serif;font-size:1.5rem;line-height:1}
.hero-meta span{font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);margin-top:4px}
/* NAV */
nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:400;display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding:11px clamp(16px,5vw,80px);background:rgba(246,241,231,.92);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);scrollbar-width:none}
nav::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
nav a{flex:0 0 auto;padding:7px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;font-size:.84rem;text-decoration:none;transition:.15s}
nav a:hover{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-color:var(--ink)}
nav a.active{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-color:var(--ink)}
main{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:56px clamp(18px,5vw,60px) 40px}
.section-label{text-align:center;margin:0 auto 40px;max-width:760px}
.section-label h2{margin:.2em 0 .3em;font-size:clamp(1.9rem,4.4vw,3rem);font-weight:600}
.section-label p{margin:0;color:var(--muted)}
.divider{margin:78px 0 40px}
/* OVERVIEW */
.overview{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:18px;margin-bottom:26px}
.ocard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.ocard .eyebrow{color:var(--c1)}
.ocard h4{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:600}
.ocard p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:.92rem}
/* TRIP MAP */
.hc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:18px}
.hc{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:20px 22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);border-top:4px solid var(--muted)}
.hc.actnow{border-top-color:#c0392b}
.hc.watch{border-top-color:var(--gold)}
.hc.good{border-top-color:var(--c3)}
.hc-tag{display:inline-block;font-size:.66rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:999px;margin-bottom:10px;color:#fff}
.hc.actnow .hc-tag{background:#c0392b}
.hc.watch .hc-tag{background:var(--gold)}
.hc.good .hc-tag{background:var(--c3)}
.hc h4{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.15}
.hc p{margin:0;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5}
.hc p b{color:var(--ink)}

/* TRAVEL TIPS */
.tips-order{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:18px 20px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);margin-bottom:22px}
.tips-order p.mini-h{margin:0 0 12px}
.tips-order ol{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;counter-reset:step}
.tips-order li{counter-increment:step;position:relative;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:7px 14px 7px 30px;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600}
.tips-order li::before{content:counter(step);position:absolute;left:6px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c1);color:#fff;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:800;display:grid;place-items:center}
.tips-order li span{color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.tips-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(340px,1fr));gap:18px}
.tipcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:20px 22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);border-top:4px solid var(--c1)}
.tipcard.t2{border-top-color:var(--c2)}.tipcard.t3{border-top-color:var(--gold)}.tipcard.t4{border-top-color:var(--c3)}
.tipcard h4{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:600}
.tipcard .sub{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:.74rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.tipcard ul{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;display:grid;gap:11px}
.tipcard li{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5;padding-left:16px;position:relative}
.tipcard li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:8px;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold)}
.tipcard li b{color:var(--ink)}
.tipcard li.flag::before{background:#c0392b;width:8px;height:8px;top:7px}
.tipcard li.flag b{color:#b5361f}

.daycost{display:inline-block;margin:8px 0 0;font-size:.76rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--c2);background:rgba(194,90,58,.1);border:1px solid rgba(194,90,58,.28);border-radius:999px;padding:3px 11px}
.budget-tbl.grand tr.total td{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:800}
.rate-note{margin:12px 2px 0;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5}

.kv.climate{margin-top:10px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
.kv.climate span{color:var(--c1)}

/* TIMING COMPARE */
.timing-compare{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:18px;margin-bottom:22px}
.tcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:20px 22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);border-top:4px solid var(--muted)}
.tcard.now{border-top-color:var(--c1)}
.tcard.later{border-top-color:var(--c2)}
.tcard.best{border-top-color:var(--c3)}
.tcard.best .tlabel{background:var(--c3)}
.tcard .tlabel{display:inline-block;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:999px;margin-bottom:10px;color:#fff}
.tcard.now .tlabel{background:var(--c1)}
.tcard.later .tlabel{background:var(--c2)}
.tcard h4{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:600}
.tcard .trow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.88rem}
.tcard .trow:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.tcard .trow span{color:var(--muted)}

.listcard.pro-list{border-top:4px solid var(--c3)}
.listcard.con-list{border-top:4px solid #c0392b}
.listcard.pro-list li::before{content:"✓";position:static;width:auto;height:auto;border-radius:0;background:none;color:var(--c3);font-weight:800;margin-right:6px}

.leaflet-popup-content{font:14px/1.4 "Inter",sans-serif}

Save money

  • Delay the rental car until leaving Nice; if quotes run high, take the train Nice→Cassis and rent after Cassis.
  • Use public beaches and water shoes instead of defaulting to private clubs.
  • Choose the 5-calanque boat, not the longest circuit.

Before you go — documents

Months ahead

  • US citizens need no Schengen visa for a normal short tourist stay.
  • Check all passports now. Kids' passports expire after 5 years.

Rental car & ZFE

Booking + pickup desk

  • Ask for automatic in writing. Manual is common.
  • Confirm Crit'Air/ZFE status before entering Nice or Marseille zones.
  • Avoid central Marseille; MRS airport is the practical endpoint.

Driving days

Short hops beat heroic detours

  • Nice → Cassis is the only long transfer.
  • Village parking is not easy in Cassis or Avignon.
  • Carry cards and a little cash for garages and tolls.

Weather, wind & fire risk

June is good, not frictionless

  • Mistral wind can wreck a beach/boat plan even on a sunny day.
  • Calanques land access is regulated Jun 1–Sep 30.
  • Inland Provence gets hot; mornings for villages, afternoons for water/pool.

Picky eating strategy

Be honest about rural Provence

  • Nice, Antibes, Aix, Avignon are easy. Cassis is expensive but manageable.
  • Valensole requires a backup plan.
  • Use grocery breakfasts and picnic lunches so dinner does not solve everything.

Smart packing

Small things that matter

  • Water shoes for pebbles, rocks, and river edges.
  • Light layers for windy boats and Mistral evenings.
  • Bug spray for river/lake stops at Pont du Gard and Sainte-Croix.
